text:
Leah (Partnerships): kicking off CircuitForge EAP. NDA in place. Need: benchmark scope, telemetry guardrails, lab booking windows, and co-announcement timing. Keep replies short.

Omar (Eng-ML): propose matrix: batch [1,4,16], seq [128,512], models: redwood-gpt-2b, community-7b-quant. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, memory per-gpu, and quality delta on 200 prompts. I'll own model runs and results.

Tess (Infra): lab access note: CircuitForge units expose two NICs; will need route rules. Staging harness at gs://redwood-eap/circuitforge/harness-v1.tar.gz. Also callout: power management firmware can throttle after ~2hrs; Jordan from partner will coordinate a longer run image.

Ivy (Legal): partners asked for per-run IDs in telemetry; we need to prohibit any raw request payload storage. I'll upload NDA amendment with explicit aggregation windows (we're proposing 24h).

Noah (Product): marketplace entry draft in drive. Suggest "CircuitForge-Validated" label. PR on copy by Mon. Marketing prefers a 3-week embargo after successful baselines.

Leah (Partnerships): action items: Omar run matrix (due +5d), Tess infra + lab booking (due +3d), Ivy NDA redline (48h), Noah marketplace copy (5d). We'll target joint blog ~2-3 weeks post-baseline. React with :white_check_mark: when confirmed.
